{"message": "Fixed the defects preventing the `ltc2959` fuel gauge test suite from building and running on `native_sim`:

1. Added the missing `compatible = "adi,ltc2959";` property to the `ltc2959@63` devicetree node in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/tests/drivers/fuel_gauge/ltc2959/boards/native_sim.overlay`, allowing `DT_HAS_ADI_LTC2959_ENABLED` to be set and the DT node to be discovered.
2. Corrected the `EMUL_LTC2959` Kconfig dependency in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/fuel_gauge/ltc2959/Kconfig` from `depends on !EMUL` to `depends on EMUL` so that the I2C emulator is compiled when `CONFIG_EMUL=y` is enabled.

Verified that the build succeeds and all 10 unit tests in the `ltc2959` test suite pass (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}
